question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is "**equal**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given passage refers to the concept of "Democracy."
 
• **The blank 4 will refer to the equality of the opportunity of opinion as provided to the citizens in a democratic country.**
 
• **Among the given options, the word "equal" ****is the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4**.
 
 
• "Equal" means having the same quantity, size, degree, value, or status.(बराबर)
 
 
• Example: Equal respect should be given to both men and women.
 
 
 
 
 
• In this context, "equal" refers to the distribution or treatment of something, suggesting fairness.

​Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: "irregular" means not following a predictable pattern or lacking consistency.(अनियमित)
 
• Option 2: "unequal" means not being the same in quantity, size, degree, value, or status.(असमान)
 
• Option 4: "unfair" means not just or impartial, often implying bias or discrimination.(अनुचित)
